Landing.title: GrowBoard
Landing.heroTitle: Your Data. Your Drive. Your Rules.
Landing.heroTagline: A Google Drive-first productivity workspace. No servers. No tracking. No data leaves your browser. Your credentials, plans, expenses, and goals live as Google Sheets in your personal Drive — fully portable, fully yours.
Landing.offlineDesc: Instant responsiveness with local Zustand state caching. No network delays or loading spinners on refresh.
Landing.sheetsDesc: Your data remains yours. Fully integrates with sheets inside your personal Google Drive for absolute data control.
Landing.widgetDesc: Configure modular cards for credentials, expenses, plans, goals, and learnings tailored to your workflow.
Landing.exploreModulesDesc: Hover over the deck components below to preview the console layouts.
Landing.credentialsModuleDesc: Store API keys and env configurations in encrypted local storage.
Landing.expensesModuleDesc: Track budgets, calculate summary stats, and download monthly sheets.
Landing.plansModuleDesc: Coordinate deadlines and action items with responsive timeline details.
Landing.goalsModuleDesc: Capture milestones and maintain habit logs in progress blocks.

DashboardTour.stepGreetingBody: This is your personal workspace. Here you can find a time-aware greeting and daily motivational quotes.
DashboardTour.stepHomeBody: Return to this main Mission Control hub at any time for an overview of your productivity.
DashboardTour.stepProjectsBody: Organize and document your active coding projects, status milestones, and notes.
DashboardTour.stepPlansBody: Set up, track, and schedule deadline milestones to keep your tasks moving forward.
DashboardTour.stepExpensesBody: Monitor budgets, log transactions, and export spreadsheets/PDF financial reports.
DashboardTour.stepGoalsBody: Define long-term achievements, habit targets, and maintain progress indicators.
DashboardTour.stepLearningBody: Document reference guides, notes, and study checklists in a rich markdown layout.
DashboardTour.stepResourcesBody: Store links, developer references, cheat sheets, and useful web assets.
DashboardTour.stepHabitsBody: Monitor daily routines, mark check-ins, and build long-term consistency with visual timelines.
DashboardTour.stepCredsBody: Securely manage project-level API keys, configurations, and environment secrets.
DashboardTour.stepProfileBody: Manage your display name, view connected account details, and check storage sync status.
DashboardTour.stepStatsBody: Quick summary tiles showing counters for all your workflow boards, synced directly with your personal Google Drive.
DashboardTour.stepRecentActivityBody: Stay updated with your latest goals, learnings, and a visual summary of your monthly expenses.
DashboardTour.stepQuickActionsBody: Easily add new goals, learnings, or manage credentials with these speed buttons.
